findings.summary: R35 now uses DOI 10.1109/FOCS.2013.30 and pages 207-216; the prior DOI pointed to an unrelated FOCS paper.
R56 now records the current Keel documentation update date, 2026-06-07.
Every retained CSV record and BibTeX key was cross-checked against its primary record; no mismatch remains on the bound corpus.
R05 uses the official NeurIPS 2025 proceedings record.
Preprint, workshop, industry, product-documentation, and whitepaper status is explicit and not counted as peer review.
Version-of-record metadata is used for FrugalGPT, Learn then Test, HAT, Acto, and Sieve.

note: The independent comparison covered all 57 retained records. Harmless display-name/diacritic normalization was allowed; identifier, author-set, year, venue, and review-status differences were not.
